content: S1: the loop owns dispatch, so the four schedulers become one (plans/row-model.md S1). Gate: one by-hand fan-out run in a scratch repo on the loop alone.

S1a delete the run_plan driver: the action, run_plan_driver_claims, run_plan_progress_snapshot and assign_task_to_session with its 200-loop cap, stall retries, credential breaker, cap recovery, utilization report and background card (tool/communicate.rs:431-1460, ~1,030 lines with tests).

S1b delete fill_slots, assign_next and assign_task; the loop's own dispatch replaces them: a holder write plus the wake a turn end already uses when the holder is headless (tool/communicate.rs:2647-2824).

S1c delete the read views and the report action: status, summary, report, plan_status, read_context, resync_plan, task_graph, expand_node, complete_node (tool/communicate.rs:2391-2646), and the instruction protocol around them (spawn reminder, assignment suffix, tldr rule, notification advice text).
S1d delete retry, wake, cleanup and stop (tool/communicate.rs:2504-2527 and 2846-2876), now that a turn ends at a close and the levers are the run's.

S1e delete the durable waiter with await_members: comm_await.rs (664), await_members_state.rs (278), the SwarmAwaitCompleted bus event and its background_tasks delivery (background_tasks.rs:204), and the wire request.

S1f delete the channels and the shared-context KV store: share, share_append, read, broadcast, dm, channel, list_channels, channel_members, subscribe_channel, unsubscribe_channel, with the store and the channel index (S1's channel cut).

S1g decide the surviving action set (a decision, not code): 32 actions are measured and S1 removes 28. Keep spawn (root only) and one message verb addressed to the owner of a named row; confirm the exact survivors and the verb's name, then prune the schema enum and canonical_swarm_action to match.
S1h unify the two dispatchers: delete auto_assign_claims and its 15 s TTL (comm_control.rs:102-137) so the pick and the holder write land in one place.

S1i unify the two liveness predicates into one assignee_is_dead used by both the sweep and dispatch (swarm.rs:567-620 waits out the reload grace, comm_control.rs:355 does not, and both carry a braid note saying so).
S1j new code, one piece: a write hook that wakes a headless holder when a row becomes ready, read off BusEvent::TodoUpdated (kcode-base/src/bus.rs:390). Nothing else may start work.

S1k the gate: one fan-out run in a scratch repo, end to end, on the loop alone, by hand on the user's own socket. A root grants, spawns two workers, hands them rows, the workers close, the root integrates and closes the anchor. If it fails, stop and report; do not patch around it.

S1l the bound (the plan's decide): one admission cap read where a spawn or a wake is admitted (MAX_SWARM_MEMBERS=1000 hard, agents.swarm_max_concurrent_agents=32 soft); run_plan's recovery dance dies with the driver; the credential-wave breaker becomes a provider-health signal that fails a turn with a clear error.

S1m reconcile S1's surface line: it counts -2 report channels, -3 artifact producers and -4 member shapes, which S2/S3/S4 own, so either the line loses them or the stage takes them. One owner per cut.
